topic: end-anchor the posting-date ISO regex to make t-al-c2 implemented
lesson: In sap-actuals.parser.ts END-ANCHOR the posting-date ISO validation regex (add a trailing $) so a string cell like '2026-07-15garbage' is REJECTED with a rows.<n>.<column> diagnostic, not silently normalized to 2026-07-15. An unanchored /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/ accepts trailing junk - that is exactly what the review marks as t-al-c2 'partial'. A criterion verdict must be 'implemented', never 'partial', to ship (task-proof 0049).
